rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a professional architect who designs buildings.

example.english: My friend is an architect who specializes in designing housing estates.
example.traditional: 我個朋友係建築師，專門設計屋苑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 hai6 gin3 zuk1 si1 zyun1 mun4 cit3 gai2 uk1 jyun2

rows.note: Use this broader term when focusing on the building designer's design role rather than specifically calling them an architect.

example.english: This architect helped us plan the look of the new restaurant.
example.traditional: 呢個設計師幫我哋諗好咗新餐廳嘅外觀。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 si1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 nam2 hou2 zo2 san1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ngoi6 gun1

rows.note: Use this for a person who plans and organizes a desired outcome, especially a project or campaign.

example.english: The company hired an architect to organize the entire publicity campaign.
example.traditional: 公司請咗一個策劃人，負責安排成個宣傳活動。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 jat1 go3 caak3 waak6 jan4 fu6 zaak3 on1 paai4 seng4 go3 syun1 cyun4 wut6 dung6
